learning_outcomes.text: The student can determine the output of a program based on the code.
The student understands the taught programming techniques and can use and explain them.
The student can apply and integrate the taught concepts and programming techniques in an extensive assignment according to the Software Development Life Cycle.
The student analyzes the objectives and desired requirements.
The student designs the architecture according to the most optimal techniques.
The student implements the different components for the solution, applying best practices.
The student integrates the different components into a fully working solution.
The student tests the developed solution.

The student can apply AI tools thoughtfully and responsibly to arrive at a solution. The student understands at all times and is critical of the output. The student owns the developed solution and can fully explain it and justify decisions made.

The student is able to clearly document, demonstrate, and explain the followed procedure and the developed solutions. The student has insight into the underlying operation of the developed assignment and can answer technical questions about it.

syllabus_topics: Responsible use of AI through the entire SDLC

assessment_methods.method: Project (Lab) demonstrated, documented and verbally explained

assessment_rules: The overall grade is composed of 40% for the written exam (Theory) and 60% for the project (Lab). If a student scores less than 6/20 for either the theory or lab component, the total grade for the course can be a maximum of 9/20. The language of assignments and the exam is English. Partial transfers are possible for successful component results (YT6107 - C#.NET Development Theory and YT6108 - C#.NET Development Lab) within the academic year.
